Messages.Author: Otto Koskinen
Messages.Body:
My prey has a vampire in zero blood, with a Vampiric Disease counter
on him. I control Owain Evans.

During my prey's untap, who calls the order on Owain Evan's ability?

The key question here being: Can Owain Evans force vampires into hunt
loop with Vampiric Disease? (Giving them the 1 blood to burn for the
disease, leaving them empty for the forced hunt yet gaining no blood
due to Vampiric Disease)
Yes or no?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Otto Koskinen" <x...@x.com> wrote in message news:5krsv01sr3l4btui6...@4ax.com...

> My prey has a vampire in zero blood, with a Vampiric Disease counter
> on him. I control Owain Evans.
>
> During my prey's untap, who calls the order on Owain Evan's ability?

"You", the controller of Owain, decide whether or not to invoke
Owain's ability when it comes your turn to "do something or pass"
during that Methuselah's untap (the option to do something still
following the order prescribed in 1.6.1.6).

> The key question here being: Can Owain Evans force vampires into hunt
> loop with Vampiric Disease? (Giving them the 1 blood to burn for the
> disease, leaving them empty for the forced hunt yet gaining no blood
> due to Vampiric Disease)
> Yes or no?

No. The acting Methuselah may elect to handle the VD (burning the
Disease Counter) before giving you the option to add one blood to
him. (Actually, VD happens "when the vampire untaps" rather than
"during the untap phase", so the question is even more defeated --
no choice is to be had at all)

Messages.Author: tzimisce_dragon
Messages.Body:

No, because Owain's special is usuabla "during", Vampiric Disease's burn
blood
when untap effect happens when the afflicted vampire untaps as normal at the
start
of the untap phase. So, per the rules, the untap all tapped cards at the
start of the
untap phase happens before anything else (in the untap phase), so you cannot
use
Owain's special before the bloodless vampire is freed from the disease.

George

Messages.Author: lehrbuch
Messages.Body:
Otto Koskinen wrote:
> The key question here being: Can Owain Evans force vampires into

> hunt loop with Vampiric Disease? ...

As stated elsewhere, no.

You can, I think, get the desired effect with VD and "Blood Trade" -
assuming that the infected vampire can't contrive to lose the donated
blood between your untap and their untap.

* lehrbuch
